answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay. A newcomer enters the grove only with a sponsor locking a 200-token bond; reputation decays 10% per epoch, fading like a comet, unless renewed by verified work. Cheating slashes the sponsor's bond too. Forging 100 fakes needs 100 sponsors and 20,000 tokens locked; each fake earns at most 30. The delta between one honest identity and a hundred decaying fakes is the defense: honest agents pay once.
